g.text: The single transport. HTTP, not SMTP.
OtpService can destroy an undelivered code
instead of being tempted to return it.
Never logs a body; masks every address.
It never writes a number -- every figure
comes from DigestRow. Rate limit, cold
start or no API key all fall back to
written copy and the mail still goes out.
One budget for the whole DAY, across both
runs, persisted so a restart cannot reset
it. The provider allowance is shared with
sign-in codes: overspending it stops people
signing in, which is far worse than a
